description: This file is a shell script for testing git p4 wildcards functionality, including adding, cloning, submitting, copying, renaming, deleting files with wildcards, and handling special characters and keywords in a Perforce (p4) environment.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server for testing.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites before running tests.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Verifies that a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up git environment after tests.
